attribution.name: 李斯
attribution.note: The museum entry says the seal script is traditionally attributed to Li Si, the chancellor accompanying the First Emperor. The record keeps that wording.
attribution.noteZh: 馆方条目称此刻石书体为秦篆，传为随行廷尉李斯所书。本记录沿用这一表述。

compositionDate.original: 秦始皇二十八年（前 219）刻，秦二世元年（前 209）补刻
compositionDate.note: The surviving block carries two lines of 219 attendants and eleven lines of the 209 edict.

background: 秦始皇二十八年（前 219）东巡登琅琊山，修琅琊台并刻石颂功；秦二世元年（前 209）在石上补刻诏书及从臣姓名。刻石原在山崖，清代被人凿下保存。现存残石为原石后半部，高 132.2 厘米，残存 13 行 87 字，藏中国国家博物馆。

review.note: Draft record from the National Museum's collection page read on 2026-11-18. The page gives the fragment's measurements and character count but no excavation, accession or condition history; the stone was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录，依据 2026-11-18 阅读的中国国家博物馆藏品页整理。该页给出残石尺寸与字数，但没有出土、入藏或保存状况记录；未核对原石。

notes: The measurements belong to the surviving fragment, not to the original cliff face.
The museum dates the inscription to 219 BCE; the surviving text is mostly the 209 BCE edict, with two lines of attendants from the earlier carving.
The attribution to Li Si is traditional; no signature or contemporary document is cited by the museum entry.
notesZh: 所记尺寸属于现存残石，不是原摩崖的整体规模。
馆方将刻石年代定为公元前 219 年；现存文字主要是前 209 年的二世诏书，另有两行前 219 年从臣题名。
归于李斯属传统说法；馆方条目未引署名或当时文献作证。
